summary: The diff implements a comprehensive Love Garden feature with visualization component, dedicated page, navigation integration, animations, and backend data types. However, the backend implementation for storing and querying garden state appears incomplete or absent from the diff.

missing_requirements.requirement: Store and persist Love Garden state in the backend including current garden level, unlocked plants, and milestone tracking
missing_requirements.reason: Backend main.mo adds GardenProgress type definition but lacks implementation of garden state storage, getLoveGardenProgress query method, and garden progression update logic when rituals/challenges are completed

missing_requirements.requirement: Badge achievements trigger visible changes in the garden
missing_requirements.reason: While LoveGardenVisualization.tsx displays badgeAchievements from GardenProgress, the diff does not show how badge achievements are mapped to garden plant unlocks in the backend or how badge completion triggers garden updates

hallucinated_features.description: Garden creation functionality with create button and mutation
hallucinated_features.reason: Garden page includes handleCreateGarden function and useCreateGarden mutation hook, but BuildRequest does not specify garden initialization/creation flow as a requirement

hallucinated_features.description: Garden accessibility check with pairing requirement
hallucinated_features.reason: Garden page implements access control checking if user is paired or admin before allowing garden access, but BuildRequest only states garden should be accessible to authenticated and paired users without specifying this validation logic

hallucinated_features.description: Celebration animation system with hasAvailableRewards detection
hallucinated_features.reason: Garden page includes showCelebration state and CompletionAnimation component triggered by gardenProgress.hasAvailableRewards, but BuildRequest does not specify reward availability detection or celebration triggers beyond plant unlock animations
